outcome: Incidence of massive transfusion due to postpartum hemorrhage
cohort: The study included all pregnant women in the Netherlands who received eight or more units of packed red blood cells from a gestational age of 20 weeks and within the first 24 hours after childbirth.
finding: The incidence of massive transfusion due to postpartum hemorrhage decreased between the 2004-2006 and 2011-2012 periods in the Netherlands, but it remained an important cause of maternal mortality and morbidity, including peripartum hysterectomy.
